Integrations

Post Hire

# Speak\_

Once integrated, recruiters can sync their jobs and candidates to the Speak\_ platform. Candidates who are in the hiring process will see information about their next interview, including the stage, the interviewer, the time & date, and a meeting link (if applicable).

## [How do I connect Speak to Ashby?](https://docs.ashbyhq.com/speak\#how-do-i-connect-speak-to-ashby) How do I connect Speak to Ashby?

For instructions on enabling the integration, please check out Speak\_’s documentation [here](https://www.notion.so/8fe034df98b34e148c48abb5ccec054c?pvs=21).
